font.family: per-demo: Vazirmatn 800 (SplitTextStagger), Lalezar (LetterformDriftAssembly), Markazi Text 700/500 (TrackingExpandReveal), Estedad 800 (TextOnPath)
font.reason: Each of the four moves has its own voice. A (rational, crisp default): Vazirmatn with true 800 weight. B (ceremonial brand reveal): Lalezar poster face, single weight, depth from the stroke pulse. C (quiet lyrical, kashida): Markazi Text, calligraphic serif with elegant tatweels; Noto Naskh Arabic was tried first and read too light. D (data-story growth line): Estedad, modern geometric sans that stays legible when pieces rotate.

comps.translatedSummary: «سامانه حرکت» rises piece by piece from under a cut line, baseline grows from the right; label «خیزش پلکانی حروف».

rtlDecisions.why: first group is right-most, stagger runs right to left (reading order)
grows from the start edge (right) to the left
up/down gravity carries no reading direction
top-left -> top-right

joined groups (6 units incl. word gap) instead of single characters; step 24/5 f keeps first jump f12, last jump f36, settle f56; mask box and cut line moved below Persian descenders; baseline width follows real text width

comps.translatedSummary: «گردهم‌آیی» pieces drift in blurred, lock with a darkening pulse, whole word breathes 1.04; label «گردآمدن شناور حروف».

rtlDecisions.why: first piece is right-most, locking proceeds right to left
random directions and symmetrical scale have no reading direction
top-left -> top-right
5 joined groups (ZWNJ becomes a gap) with STAG 21/4 f so last lock stays f66; letterSpacing 8 removed; same seeds, pulse, breath f80-104

comps.translatedSummary: «نفس بکش» stretches open with kashida under blur, words slide out of an overlapped pile; subtitle «ورود سینمایی تیتر» fades in; label «باز شدن کشیدهٔ حروف».

rtlDecisions.why: tracking breaks Persian joins; replaced by integer kashida (tatweel) steps per joint 0 -> 2 on the same out-poly(5) p curve, word pile translateX, scaleX .92, blur 10 -> 0
first word on the right, each word slides outward from the centre to its own side
top-left -> top-right
symmetrical
removed, letterSpacing 0

comps.translatedSummary: «رشد تا آخرین قله» pieces ride a rising curve, tangent-rotated, then straighten into the title; label «متن روی مسیر».

rtlDecisions.why: x -> 1920-x: climbs from lower-right to upper-left as a RTL time axis reads
first-read right-most piece makes the shortest trip, last piece the farthest
text reads leftwards so upright angle is -theta of the original tangent
centres measured from a hidden RTL flex row instead of a fixed 46 px grid, since joined groups have varying widths
top-left -> top-right
piece start = s*34 f, 45 f travel, 8 f hold, 12 f settle, curve evolve 0-82: same envelope, last settle f99

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets in this card; the curve is an SVG path and all text is live DOM text.
concerns: Registry durations are 56 f but the designs are 130-150 f; inspected and rendered with --duration 150 (no code offsets)
TextOnPath uses a measured layout (font-ready polling + getBoundingClientRect), deterministic per render but depends on the font file loading
Kashida steps in TrackingExpandReveal are integer jumps hidden by blur in the first ~12 f
